text: cool. another thing for me you can do is in the actual top chrome, we need the window controls. like the x and the square and the line for minimize and maximize and close
resolution: Added real host-backed window controls to the editor top chrome: minimize, maximize, and close buttons now sit at the far right of Chrome.tsx and call the runtime window FFI functions. Marked the editor manifest customChrome=true and made the top chrome windowDrag so packaged editor builds run borderless with the editor-owned titlebar. Added matching classifier styles for neutral min/max hover and red close hover. Verified ship detects customChrome/windowDrag and built the editor; also captured a headless screenshot showing the controls render without overlap.
